_documentation.purpose: Compare early laser-driven vortex motion with pinning disabled and with a Gaussian defect at the vortex. Each case has a cloned laser-off control.
_documentation.relies_on: The referenced NbN simulation defines the mesh, material, two-temperature coefficients, TDGL integration and timestep. This runner overrides the pinning landscape, laser, field and applied current for each case.
_documentation.interpretation: Pinning strengths are dimensionless reductions of the local GL coefficient, not calibrated pinning forces. Reported gradients are drive proxies, and velocity is dark-subtracted finite-window motion. Short runs may end before thermal equilibration or depinning.

fields.simulation_config: Base simulation JSON for material, film, TDGL and thermal solver settings.
fields.applied_field_T: Uniform perpendicular magnetic field in tesla.
fields.initial_vortex: Initial topological vortex seed in fractional film coordinates with charge and core radius.
fields.seed_position_m: Physical vortex seed used as the reference for defect and laser positions.
fields.pinning.enabled: False forces an unpinned sweep; true sweeps the listed strengths, including zero as an unpinned control.
fields.pinning.strengths: Dimensionless Gaussian GL-coefficient suppression amplitudes. Zero disables the defect for that case.
fields.pinning.sigma_m: Gaussian defect standard deviation in metres.
fields.pinning.site_offset_m: Defect-center [dx,dy] from the seed in metres; [0,0] starts the vortex at the defect.
fields.pinning.maximum_suppression: Cap on total dimensionless GL-coefficient suppression.
fields.sweep.direction: Beam direction from the seed; normalized by the runner.
fields.sweep.offsets_m: Beam distances from the seeded vortex in metres.
fields.sweep.powers_W: Absorbed, not incident, laser powers in watts.
fields.sweep.spot_sigma_m: Gaussian optical-heating spot standard deviation in metres.
fields.timing.dark_steps: Laser-off preparation steps before each case branches into illuminated and dark controls.
fields.timing.exposure_steps: Maximum short-time exposure steps; stops early if the electron temperature reaches Tc.
fields.timing.sample_every: Accepted steps between velocity and local-gradient samples.
fields.output_directory: Base result path; numbered runs preserve previous results.
